topic.label: Claude Apps on Third-Party Platforms
topic.desc: Claude Apps on Third-Party Platforms: Install and administer, Inference providers and models, Configuration, Connectors and extensions, Using Claude Desktop and operations.

concepts: Install and administer: Overview, Features, Installation and setup, Deploy with Enterprise Admin Console, Deploy with MDM, Deploy with a bootstrap server, In-app configuration, Write a credential helper, Import history from claude.ai, Migrate Claude Desktop from a cloud provider to Claude Enterprise, Sign in through the OS identity broker.

Inference providers and models: Models and effort levels, Deploy Claude Desktop on 3P with an LLM gateway, Deploy Claude Desktop on 3P with Amazon Bedrock, Deploy Claude Desktop on 3P with Amazon Bedrock Mantle, Deploy Claude Desktop on 3P with Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Deploy Claude Desktop on 3P with Microsoft Foundry, Deploy Claude Desktop on 3P with the Claude API.
Configuration: Configuration implementation, Configuration reference, Configuration changelog.

Connectors and extensions: MCP, plugins, skills, and hooks, Set up sign-in for managed MCP servers, Built-in connectors, Connect to Microsoft 365, Connect to GitHub, Connect to Google Cloud, Connect to Box, Connect to Salesforce, Web search and web fetch, Built-in browser and Claude in Chrome, Desktop and filesystem access.

Using Claude Desktop and operations: Unified Claude in Claude Desktop on 3P, Chat in Claude Desktop on 3P, Code in Claude Desktop on 3P, SSH remote sessions in Claude Desktop on 3P, Show a status line, Telemetry and egress, Network proxy, User identity and local data, Legal and compliance.

provenance.basis: Human0's claude_domain.csv (sha256 d26d41d8da4ed7dd622b6e6faa18a97dc91d4f3d2af972ae9715d41ee94963cc), converted by tools/claude_domain/build_claude_packs.py on 2026-11-27. Topics, concepts, skills (docs pages) and agent names are Human0's. A single-page skill's description is that page's own one-line description where the site publishes one (page_descriptions.json: llms.txt / llms-full.txt fetched 2026-11-27); concept descriptions, other skill descriptions, keywords, skill types (a verb rule), ids and the lexicon are generated from the CSV text.
provenance.mcp_notes: Human0's CSV lists 'Claude Developer Platform docs' for this topic, but that server (Claude Platform Docs, directory cc6f3470-080c-45b8-84e1-cdc03e9c6ac1) covers platform.claude.com only, by its own instructions, and a search for 'Claude Code hooks' on 2026-11-27 returned only platform.claude.com pages. No MCP server for these docs was verified, so the pack lists none.
provenance.limitations: Skills without a published page description (API reference endpoints and some guides) are described by their titles only; skill types come from the first word of the title. Docs pages change: the URLs were current in the CSV, not re-checked here.
